# TheGreeter

> TheGreeter is an interactive wish and birthday website maker. You create a private, personalized web page with someone's photos, background music or a voice note, a heartfelt letter, and interactive celebrations like virtual blow-candle cake cutting, midnight countdowns, or runaway Yes/No proposal buttons — then send it as a single shareable link and printable QR code. Designing and live previewing is free, publishing starts at a one-time ₹59 in India (regional pricing elsewhere, no subscription), and the page opens instantly in any browser worldwide without downloading an app.

TheGreeter is built for people who want a digital gift that feels thoughtful rather than bought: long-distance partners, friends living in different cities, couples celebrating milestones, families, and anyone tired of generic e-cards or plain "HBD" text messages. Every published page is 100% ad-free for the recipient, works in both English and Hindi, and includes a secret 4–6 digit Edit PIN so you can update photos, messages, or music anytime without changing the link.

Key facts:
- Product: personalized, interactive digital greeting cards and surprise celebration websites
- Occasions: birthdays, anniversaries, romantic proposals, Valentine's Day, apologies (sorry), thank you / gratitude, and festivals (Diwali, Christmas, New Year)
- What goes in it: photo memories and polaroids, background songs or recorded voice notes, written love letters/notes, interactive virtual cake with blowable candles, midnight countdown timer, virtual hug, and animated confetti or petals
- Languages: English and Hindi (including AI-assisted story/wish writing and localized templates)
- Price: free to build and preview; one-time payment to publish starting at ₹59 (Starter 14 days), ₹99 (Pro 30 days), ₹149 (Pro+ 100 days), and ₹299 (Infinity Lifetime) in India (regional pricing in USD, GBP, EUR, CAD, AUD, AED); no recurring subscriptions
- Time to create: under 2 minutes, no coding or design skills required
- Delivery: one shareable web link (custom vanity URLs like `https://thegreeter.in/demo-raman` included on Pro, Pro+, and Infinity) plus a high-resolution printable QR code
- Recipient experience: 100% ad-free, instant mobile/desktop browser viewing, no sign-up or app required
